home.heroLede:
Not an empty starter — a working admin framework:
the shared layer is ready, and you maintain the business layer.
home.new.text: Install and download plugins as source from the market
home.principle1.title: The shared core ships built in
home.principle1.desc: Users, roles, menus, files, messages, and monitoring already have screens and APIs, ready after setup.
home.principle2.title: Add capabilities without changing the framework
home.principle2.desc: Package business features as source plugins; connect sign-in, tenancy, events, and jobs through extension points in your own area.
home.principle3.title: Upgrades keep your business code
home.principle3.desc: Framework and user code live in separate directories. Upgrades never overwrite business code, and you never maintain a private fork.
home.source.title:
Framework stays framework,
your code stays yours
home.source.sub: Business code, pages, plugins, configuration, and migrations stay in the user area, untouched by upgrades; go.mod and web/package.json merge dependencies separately.
home.source.aria: The myapp directory tree: core, modules, and web/src/framework are framework areas; internal, plugins, and web/src/pages are user areas; dependency manifests merge separately
home.extension.f2: Backend and frontend in one package
home.cap.title:
30 built-in modules
for everyday admin work
home.cap.sub: Accounts, content, files, messages, monitoring, and the open platform ship as modules, with documented routes and permission codes.

docs.desc: Framework docs for development, plugins, deployment and configuration.
docs.footerHint: Docs ship with each release. For updates see
home.statement.strong: An admin framework, delivered as source.
home.statement.rest: The shared layer ships ready; your business code stays in its own directory, and framework upgrades leave it untouched.
home.intg.title: Fits the tools you already run
home.intg.sub: OAuth2/OIDC sign-in, S3-compatible storage, Prometheus metrics, and webhook events use standard protocols; availability depends on configuration and plugin status.

as plugins
